name: MonarchCheckboxGroup
title: CheckboxGroup
wrapsNative: Toggle with .toggleStyle(.monarchCheckbox) for each choice, Toggle(sources:isOn:label:) for select all, inside MonarchFormField
summary: A labelled set of checkboxes for picking any number of choices, with an optional "Select all" that is checked, mixed or clear.
whenToUse: For a short list of independent choices where any number can be picked, such as notification topics or days of the week.
whenNotToUse: Not for one choice out of several (use a Picker or MonarchRadioCardGroup), not for a setting that applies at once (use a Toggle switch), and not for a long or searchable list (use List with selection or MonarchCombobox).
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<Set<String>>, options: [MonarchCheckboxGroupOption], helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, layout: MonarchCheckboxGroupLayout = .vertical, isRequired: Bool = false, showsSelectAll: Bool = false, labels: MonarchCheckboxGroupLabels = MonarchCheckboxGroupLabels())
struct MonarchCheckboxGroupOption: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable { init(id: String, label: String, description: String? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false) }
struct MonarchCheckboxGroupLabels { init(selectAll: String? = nil, field: MonarchFormFieldLabels = MonarchFormFieldLabels()) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible group label, already localised. It names the group for VoiceOver.

options.name: selection
options.description: The ids of the checked choices.

options.name: options
options.description: The choices in order, each with an id, a label, an optional description and an optional disabled flag.

options.name: helper
options.description: Help text, shown under the choices and read as the group's hint.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, such as "Choose at least one day". Shown with an icon in place of the help text and announced.

options.name: layout
options.description: vertical: one choice per line. horizontal: side by side, wrapping; stacked at the accessibility text sizes.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds "Required" to the hint. The group does not enforce a minimum; pass error.

options.name: showsSelectAll
options.description: Adds a "Select all" checkbox above the choices, which are indented under it.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Select all" and for the field's spoken "Required" and error form.

states.name: select all off
states.description: No enabled choice is checked; the box is empty.

states.name: select all mixed
states.description: Some enabled choices are checked; the box is filled with a minus glyph and VoiceOver reads the mixed value. Pressing it checks every enabled choice.

states.name: select all on
states.description: Every enabled choice is checked; pressing it clears them. Disabled choices keep their state.

states.name: option disabled
states.description: The choice cannot be changed; its box, label and description use the disabled roles.

states.name: error
states.description: The error replaces the help text, with an icon, and is announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With .disabled(true) every choice and select all are disabled and the label dims.

appearance: The label in the label style, then the checkboxes of MonarchCheckboxToggleStyle: accent strong fill when checked, surface fill and input border when not. Descriptions use the muted text role, disabled parts the disabled roles, and the error the danger strong role. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web group takes value and defaultValue; iOS uses one Binding<Set<String>>, so the order of checked values is not kept (read it from options). The form name for submission does not apply. Inside a web Field the group takes the Field's label; on iOS the label, help and error are parameters, drawn by MonarchFormField. The mixed state is the system's Toggle(sources:) mixed state, the same mechanism Android's tri-state checkbox mirrors.
accessibility: The choices are inside one container labelled with the group label, whose hint is the error ("Error: …"), the help text and "Required", each when present; a new error is announced.
Each choice is a standard Toggle given to VoiceOver through the checkbox style's accessibility representation, read with its label and description.
Select all is a standard Toggle(sources:isOn:), so VoiceOver reads its on, off and mixed values.
Every checkbox row is at least 44 points high and the whole row, label included, is the touch target.
The mixed state is shown by a minus glyph and checked by a check mark, not by colour alone.
edgeCases: With no options, select all is disabled.
Disabled choices are left as they are by select all, and are not counted when deciding between mixed and on.
Long labels and descriptions wrap; the horizontal layout wraps onto more lines and stacks at the accessibility sizes.

examples.title: With select all
examples.template:
MonarchCheckboxGroup(
    {{label}},
    selection: $selection,
    options: [
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: {{options.0.value}}, label: {{options.0.label}}, description: {{options.0.description}}),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: {{options.1.value}}, label: {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: {{options.2.value}}, label: {{options.2.label}}),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: {{options.3.value}}, label: {{options.3.label}}, isDisabled: {{options.3.disabled}}),
    ],
    showsSelectAll: {{selectAll}}
)
examples.code:
MonarchCheckboxGroup(
    "Notify me by",
    selection: $selection,
    options: [
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: "email", label: "Email", description: "To your sign-in address."),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: "sms", label: "Text message"),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: "push", label: "Push notification"),
        MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: "post", label: "Post", isDisabled: true),
    ],
    showsSelectAll: true
)

examples.title: Days in a wrapping row, with validation
examples.code:
MonarchCheckboxGroup(
    "Working days",
    selection: $days,
    options: ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"].map { MonarchCheckboxGroupOption(id: $0, label: $0) },
    error: days.isEmpty ? "Choose at least one day." : nil,
    layout: .horizontal,
    isRequired: true
)
